tasks.short: Develop dance ideas and record actual influences in notes and sketches.

steps.what: Find and revisit actual influence references for the developing dance idea
inputs: actual reference collection maintained by the choreographer

steps.what: Develop original dance ideas through reflection and physical movement exploration
Write fresh notes and draw sketches recording ideas and their actual influences
outputs: authored notes and sketches with influence references

steps.what: Arrange note pages and reference links and save the ordinary internal idea notebook
inputs: authored notes and sketches with influence references

tasks.design: Configure native media bookmarks and notebook page styles to revisit chosen influence references and arrange authored notes. Fresh ideas, sketches and the account of an influence remain the choreographer's work; ordinary saves are retained without an approval stage.
tasks.previous_blocker: References and sketches can be scattered across media files and note pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bookmarks and reusable page styles reduce repeated retrieval and arrangement.
tasks.still_hard: Original movement ideas and meaningful influence attribution remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Sense what an influence contributes to a new dance rather than reproducing its surface.
tasks.altitude: Keep a traceable idea notebook while spending more attention on movement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native media bookmarks and document page styles support retrieval and arrangement, not original choreography.

assumptions: OTHER is the existing media player/library. Shares20/50/25/5 are provisional, not measured. The choreographer maintains actual references in s1 and writes/sketches fresh material in s3; no uncounted tagging, transcription or generated dance idea is assumed.
s1 removes3 points of repeated retrieval and s4 removes2 of arrangement; ordinary save time within s4 is fully retained. Existing bookmark use receives no credit.
unknowns: Are reference retrieval and note arrangement actually repeated?
research_questions: Observe reuse of references separately from creative exploration.

incremental.description: Maintain useful bookmarks and notebook page styles.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 retrieval plus2 page-arrangement points less0.5 upkeep. Low: mostly new offline influences require fresh looking and sketches; only0.5 repeated file retrieval and0.5 stable page layout disappear, less0.5 upkeep. Idea development50 and fresh note/sketch capture25 remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate actual production music with music directors.

steps.what: Retrieve current music selections and their existing cue references before coordination
inputs: current selections and cue records maintained by production and music director

steps.what: Coordinate music interpretation, timing and actual changes directly with music directors
inputs: actual dance intentions and production constraints
outputs: actual music coordination decisions captured by the choreographer

steps.what: Write assigned music coordination notes and cue changes in the internal production record
inputs: actual music coordination decisions captured by the choreographer
outputs: authored coordination record and cue changes

tasks.design: Use a native bookmarked production-music view to retrieve the current selections and cue references. Retain artistic coordination, actual decision capture and the choreographer's assigned written cue changes; no automatic message or music change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Locating the current music version can interrupt coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing file links and version views can reduce only repeated navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Music interpretation and agreement with the director remain relational and artistic.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve a timing conflict through shared musical understanding.
tasks.altitude: Enter coordination with the current references at hand.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: file version views can expose current music references without resolving artistic coordination.

assumptions: OTHER is the existing production media library. Provisional shares10/70/20 are not measured. Only1 point of s1 repeated navigation disappears, not listening or checking versions. Actual fresh capture remains s2 and actual assigned writing s3.

The music director's labour is not counted or reduced. If no written cue record is assigned, remove s3 and reweight actual work; do not invent a transcript or send. Native saves in s3 remain fully retained and ungated.
unknowns: Which cue changes does the choreographer actually record?
research_questions: How often is finding the current music file repeated rather than already direct?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1 repeated reference-navigation point less0.3 upkeep. Low: a new composition has no reusable reference route, so all retrieval remains and net benefit floors at0 after upkeep. Coordination70 and authored cue records20 remain in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design dances for actual performers, productions and skill levels.

steps.what: Understand actual performers, production context, artistic purpose and practical constraints
outputs: understood dance context and performer needs

steps.what: Design and test actual dance movement suited to the performers and production
inputs: understood dance context and performer needs
outputs: actual designed movement and sequence choices

steps.what: Record the designed sequence using authored notes, sketches and existing cue-page styles
inputs: actual designed movement and sequence choices

tasks.design: Use native cue-page styles for the actual written sequence record after the choreographer designs the dance. Remove only repeated headings and page arrangement; actual movement creation, suitability testing, fresh notation and ordinary internal saves remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reformatting cue pages can recur when documenting designed sequences.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document styles reuse presentation without inventing dance content.
tasks.still_hard: Dance quality and suitability for actual bodies, skills and venues remain contextual.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the same artistic intention to beginners or professionals through actual movement understanding.
tasks.altitude: Reuse presentation and retain authorship of the dance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native cue-page styles can reuse document presentation while fresh dance notation and movement choices remain authored.

assumptions: Shares20/65/15 are provisional, not measured. s3 removes3 formatting points only where the choreographer actually records the design; fresh notes, sketches and save remain retained12. No transcript, motion capture or automatic choreography is assumed.

The diverse production types are alternative contexts, not separate baseline tasks all performed every time. Reweight if no design record is actually produced rather than adding paperwork to justify a tool.
unknowns: Do the actual cue records have reusable presentation?
research_questions: Which formatting operations repeat across the actual production's dance records?

incremental.description: Maintain cue-page styles for actual dance records.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 cue-page formatting points less0.5 upkeep. Low: a site-specific improvised production needs new sketches and a different record structure, leaving only0.7 stable heading points removable, less0.5 upkeep. Performer understanding20 and movement design65 remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Audition performers and capture actual observations for dance parts.

steps.what: Define actual dance-part requirements and prepare the audition observations form
inputs: actual dance parts and production needs
outputs: human-defined audition criteria and observation form

steps.what: Audition performers through actual demonstrations and assess suitability for the dance parts
inputs: human-defined audition criteria and observation form
outputs: actual audition observations captured by choreographer

steps.what: Write actual audition observations in the internal performer record using native form fields
inputs: actual audition observations captured by choreographer
human-defined audition criteria and observation form

tasks.design: Use a native audition observation form to avoid repeatedly typing stable part headings. The choreographer auditions and judges actual performers and writes all fresh observations; there is no model ranking, candidate filtering, automated suitability inference or casting message.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable part and observation headings can be retyped in individual records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form fields reuse those headings while retaining actual observation capture.
tasks.still_hard: Artistic suitability and interaction with the actual performer remain human.
tasks.human_edge: See expressive potential that a fixed form cannot measure.
tasks.altitude: Keep observation records consistent without delegating audition judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document forms can reuse stable audition headings without evaluating candidates.

assumptions: Shares15/70/15 are provisional, not measured. s2 counts actual observation capture; s3 removes only1.5 points of stable heading entry, retaining fresh prose, factual checking and the ordinary save. No extra author approval is inserted.

This task auditions performers; casting offers and rejection sends are not generated here. Any actual assigned communication must be separately mapped before extending the design. Access to observations remains limited to the actual production team.
unknowns: Are performer records already generated from an audition form?
research_questions: Observe actual note entry and stable-heading repetition without scoring artistic quality automatically.

incremental.description: Maintain actual part headings and access for the audition form.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1.5 repeated heading-entry points less0.4 upkeep. Low: multiple unusual parts require bespoke observation sections, leaving only0.5 stable production-heading points removable, less0.4 upkeep. Criteria15 and actual audition70 remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain movement authorship and performer judgement while simplifying actual reference and note handling.
skills_to_grow: Separate observed audition facts from artistic judgement
role.ambitious_version: Maintain clear records across productions without substituting generated movement or performer rankings for choreography.
